behavior: Owned repository-scoped snapshot metadata is a candidate for the existing create(snapshot_id) action. Creation uses a distinct new named row. Old rows/snapshot identifiers are retained. Failed provider restoration retains the new failed row and offers fresh creation. Private app intent records source, name and actor before POST, returns immediately, deduplicates, reconciles reload without reposting ambiguous writes, verifies omitted source facts via existing detail GET, and keeps the shared toast through actual completion. Recovery request persists the original effective bookmark and explicitly selected kind before POST. Launch, owner-scoped reconciliation and completion use those immutable source facts; ordinary old-row refresh cannot change them. A source mismatch retains the original request/new-row identity, refuses completion and cannot resend the ambiguous operation. A null bookmark records an explicit backend-default choice: current CreateWorkspace resolves omitted source to the repository default before fresh or snapshot creation. The predicate accepts that backend-selected bookmark while retaining exact snapshot and selected-kind checks, explicit bookmark checks, name reconciliation, owner stamps and no-repost semantics.
